vulnerability.name: USN-8013-1
vulnerability.description: Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to compromise the system. This update corrects flaws in the following subsystems:   - Cryptographic API;   - SMB network file system; (CVE-2025-38561, CVE-2025-40019)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in the Linux kernel.
